description: Source code implementing quantized convolution operations using cuDNN backend in PyTorch, including functions for creating convolution descriptors, applying convolution with optional ReLU fusion, and handling quantization parameters and caching.

classes.name: CacheKey
classes.description: Struct used as key for caching cuDNN execution plans, including convolution parameters and data alignments.

classes.name: QConv1dInt8
classes.description: Template class for 1D quantized convolution with optional ReLU fusion.

classes.name: QConvInt8
classes.description: Template class for 2D quantized convolution with optional ReLU fusion.

methods.name: getConvDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN convolution descriptor based on data type, padding, stride, and dilation.

methods.name: apply_impl_helper
methods.description: Performs the core convolution operation, including setting up descriptors, caching, and executing cuDNN plans.

methods.name: apply_impl
methods.description: Prepares input tensor (padding if necessary) and calls apply_impl_helper to perform convolution.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Performs convolution with fused ReLU activation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Static method to execute quantized convolution, handling 1D case by reshaping.
